sections.content: QAOA is a hybrid variational algorithm for combinatorial optimization. It alternates cost and mixer unitaries. MaxCut is the standard demo.

sections.code:
import os, sys
_LQE = os.environ.get("LQE_PATH", os.path.abspath(os.path.join("..", "legitimate_quantum_engine_v5.0")))
_ECO = os.environ.get("LQE_ECOSYSTEM_PATH", os.path.abspath(".."))
for _p in (_LQE, _ECO):
    if _p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, _p)
from legitimate_quantum_engine.solvers.qaoa import QAOA
edges = [(0,1),(1,2),(2,0)]
qaoa = QAOA(3, edges, p=1, max_iterations=40)
out = qaoa.solve(verbose=False)
print(f'QAOA p=1 energy={out["energy"]:.6f} exact={out["exact"]:.6f}')
